title: Recover an unfinished checkout or delayed billing update
summary: Continue the saved payment safely, or close it before reviewing another selection.

sections.title: Keep the saved payment in view
sections.body: An unfinished checkout retains the locations, staff count and billing cycle submitted for that payment. Your visible calculator estimate can remain editable, but it does not change that saved request. Do not start a second payment in another tab.

sections.title: Use the available recovery action
sections.body:
1. Return to **Subscription & billing → Plan** and read the unfinished-checkout notice and saved selection.
2. Select **Check billing status** to get the current result. If the platform is verifying a payment, allow it to finish.
3. Use **Continue secure checkout** when offered to return to the same checkout.
4. If you need a different selection and **Start again** is available, select it and wait for the original checkout to close. Then review the new selection before confirming.
5. If payment already completed, check your subscription and invoice instead of paying again.

sections.title: When checks cannot complete
sections.body: The notice explains what remains saved. Wait for **You can check again in…** or **You can try again in…** before another attempt. There is no need to repeatedly click or refresh. When the issue needs the ClipperDesk team, use **Contact support** and include the safe **Support reference** displayed. If the notice offers **Start again**, it lets you review a fresh checkout without losing your edited selection. If **Open invoices** is shown, use it to complete the existing payment before starting another purchase.

sections.title: What to send support
sections.body: Include the business name, approximate time, visible status and support reference. Say whether you left checkout, saw a bank charge or returned without an update. Never send card numbers, passwords or private sign-in links. Some payment-account problems can only be resolved by the platform team; repeated checkout attempts cannot repair them.

sections.title: After recovery
sections.body: Check your subscription, included locations and staff, next billing date and invoice. If a payment is still pending, check its status before trying to pay again. An expired checkout page does not mean a payment was refunded.
